shortDescription: Module for setup of WafPolicyPSMGroup Avi RESTful Object

options.name: api_context
options.description: Avi API context that includes current session ID and CSRF Token. This allows user to perform single login and re-use the session.

options.name: api_version
options.description: Avi API version of to use for Avi API and objects.

options.name: avi_api_patch_op
options.description: Patch operation to use when using avi_api_update_method as patch.

options.name: avi_api_update_method
options.description: Default method for object update is HTTP PUT. Setting to patch will override that behavior to use HTTP PATCH.

options.name: avi_credentials
options.description: Avi Credentials dictionary which can be used in lieu of enumerating Avi Controller login details.

options.name: avi_deactivate_session_cache_as_fact
options.displayName: Avi Deactivate Session Cache As Fact
options.description: It disables avi session information to be cached as a fact.

options.name: avi_patch_path
options.description: Patch path to use when using avi_api_update_method as patch.

options.name: avi_patch_value
options.description: Patch value to use when using avi_api_update_method as patch.

options.name: completely_described_match_elements
options.description: A list of all match element collections which are completely described in the psm group. Every input value which matches one of the elements in this list but is not handled by a waf psm rule, will run the match_element miss_action. Allowed values are waf_variable_args. Enum options - WAF_VARIABLE_ARGS, WAF_VARIABLE_ARGS_GET, WAF_VARIABLE_ARGS_POST, WAF_VARIABLE_ARGS_NAMES, WAF_VARIABLE_REQUEST_COOKIES, WAF_VARIABLE_QUERY_STRING, WAF_VARIABLE_REQUEST_BASENAME, WAF_VARIABLE_REQUEST_URI, WAF_VARIAB

options.name: configpb_attributes
options.description: Protobuf versioning for config pbs. Field introduced in 21.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: controller
options.description: IP address or hostname of the controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_CONTROLLER).

options.name: description
options.description: Free-text comment about this group. Field introduced in 18.2.3. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: enable
options.description: Enable or disable this waf rule group. Field introduced in 18.2.3. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as True.

options.name: hit_action
options.description: If a rule in this group matches the match_value pattern, this action will be executed. Allowed actions are waf_action_no_op and waf_action_allow_parameter. Enum options - WAF_ACTION_NO_OP, WAF_ACTION_BLOCK, WAF_ACTION_ALLOW_PARAMETER. Field introduced in 18.2.3. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as WAF_ACTION_ALLOW_PARAMETER.

options.name: is_learning_group
options.description: This field indicates that this group is used for learning. Field introduced in 18.2.3. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: location_match_miss_action
options.description: If there is no location matching the request, this action will be executed. Allowed actions are waf_action_no_op and waf_action_block. Enum options - WAF_ACTION_NO_OP, WAF_ACTION_BLOCK, WAF_ACTION_ALLOW_PARAMETER. Field introduced in 31.2.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as WAF_ACTION_NO_OP.

options.name: locations
options.description: Positive security model locations. These are used to partition the application name space. Field introduced in 18.2.3. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: markers
options.description: List of labels to be used for granular rbac. Field introduced in 20.1.5. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: miss_action
options.description: If a rule in this group does not match the match_value pattern, this action will be executed. Allowed actions are waf_action_no_op and waf_action_block. Enum options - WAF_ACTION_NO_OP, WAF_ACTION_BLOCK, WAF_ACTION_ALLOW_PARAMETER. Field introduced in 18.2.3. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as WAF_ACTION_NO_OP.

options.name: name
options.description: User defined name of the group. Field introduced in 18.2.3. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: password
options.description: Password of Avi user in Avi controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_PASSWORD).

options.name: state
options.description: The state that should be applied on the entity.

options.name: tenant
options.description: Name of tenant used for all Avi API calls and context of object.

options.name: tenant_ref
options.description: Tenant that this object belongs to. It is a reference to an object of type tenant. Field introduced in 18.2.3. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: tenant_uuid
options.description: UUID of tenant used for all Avi API calls and context of object.

options.name: url
options.description: Avi controller URL of the object.

options.name: username
options.description: Username used for accessing Avi controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_USERNAME).

options.name: uuid
options.description: Uuid of this object. Field introduced in 18.2.3. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.
